reasoning_review.measurement_and_timing: Quarter dates, kCU displays, integer CU minor units, normal display balances and debit-positive posting convention are explicit. Opening temporary accounts are closed. Supplied accrual recognition, collectibility, depreciation timing, historical cost, no tax/FX/OCI/overdraft and ordered payment assumptions are sufficient for the numerical tasks.
reasoning_review.statement_derivation: Profit, retained earnings, contributed capital, distributions and borrowing are distinguished. Direct cash lines are derived from the appropriate revenue, expense and working-capital roll-forwards; indirect signs use normal balances. The chapter states the absence of other changes required by those derivations.
reasoning_review.equipment: The disposal removes gross cost and its associated accumulated depreciation, measures gain against carrying amount, puts full cash proceeds in investing and reverses gain in indirect CFO. Depreciation is an allocation rather than cash funding. The direct seller note increases equipment and debt without invented gross cash flows.
reasoning_review.classification: Cash interest operating and dividends financing are explicitly maintained teaching conventions. The alternative interest exercise consistently removes interest payable from operating working capital and adds back the entire interest expense; its total cash remains invariant. Current/noncurrent maturity classification is supplied separately and does not select a cash-flow category.
reasoning_review.liquidity: Delayed collection changes cash and receivables, not profit, under certain collectibility. With collection 10, the cash path remains nonnegative through principal repayment and reaches 2 immediately before the dividend; the planned dividend 8 needs 6 additional funding. Both proposed repairs act before declaration/payment and have distinct liability/equity consequences. No claim is made that zero ending cash certifies future solvency or lawful distribution.
reasoning_review.error_detection: The balanced wrong-revenue receipt correctly demonstrates cancellation between excess profit and excess receivables in an indirect bridge. Balanced journals, equity identities and matching cash totals cannot establish recognition or completeness. A wrong borrowing cash tag can preserve ending cash while overstating CFO and understating CFF; separate evidence and a correctly defined indirect bridge can expose it.
reasoning_review.value_and_scope: Book equity, liquidation residual, current assets and dated payment capacity are distinguished. The hypothetical sale-value example is not a market valuation estimate. The accounting arithmetic does not silently assert that simplified subtotals are IFRS-defined operating profit.

exercise_audit.result: All eight independent transaction vectors preserve change in assets = change in liabilities + change in equity; owner cash and debt enter CFF, delivered cash service and receivable collections enter CFO, note acquisition has no cash, depreciation is noncash and dividends reduce equity without reducing profit.
Profit 9; retained earnings 23; cash 20; receivables 13; inventory 14; net equipment 27; assets 74 = liabilities 31 + equity 43. Direct and indirect CFO 7, CFI 0, CFF -7 and zero cash change.
Receipts 60; purchases 47; supplier cash 41; wages 10; insurance 3; interest 3; profit 8; operating NWC increase 9; direct and indirect CFO 3.

Disposed carrying amount 12, gain 2; gross equipment 115, accumulated depreciation 29, net equipment 86; CFI -6; note 25 noncash; 26 net increase + 7 depreciation + 12 disposed carrying amount - 25 noncash = cash capex 20. Income effect -5 plus indirect adjustments 7 - 2 gives zero CFO.

CFO 26, CFI -19, CFF 22; total cash change 29. The alternative NWC increase is 13, and profit 25 + depreciation 9 - gain 1 + interest expense 6 - 13 = 26. Adding interest payable again would double-count the adjustment.

Unfunded cash -6 and CFO -54; independent prefix check confirms 2 cash before the final dividend. Borrowing 6 and choosing dividend 2 both give cash 0, assets 292 and CFF 33; liabilities/equity are respectively 149/143 and 143/149.

Wrong recognition leaves cash unchanged but overstates AR, profit, assets and retained equity by 5; (P + 5) - (change AR + 5) = P - change AR, including loss/decreasing-AR test values. A loan tagged as CFO overstates CFO and understates CFF by the same 10 without altering their sum.
Tomorrow funding gaps 0 or 3 depending on collection timing; immediate-sale residual 9 + 15 + 4 + 10 - 20 = 18, compared with book equity 30 under a different scenario.
